# Tyk Documentation

> Product documentation for Tyk, an API and AI gateway platform. It covers Tyk Gateway (open source), Tyk Dashboard, Tyk Developer Portal, MCP Gateway, Tyk AI Studio and Tyk Cloud: installing and upgrading them, securing and controlling API and AI agent traffic, and the configuration and API references.

## How to read these docs

- Every page is also available as Markdown. Add `.md` to the page URL. For example, https://tyk.io/docs/ai-management/mcp-gateway/overview is also available at https://tyk.io/docs/ai-management/mcp-gateway/overview.md.
- Unversioned URLs such as `https://tyk.io/docs/<page>.md` are the latest release (v5.15). Other versions use a version prefix, such as `https://tyk.io/docs/5.13/<page>.md` for v5.13, the Long Term Support (LTS) release. Versions 5.8 and later support `.md`. Versions 5.7 and earlier are older HTML-only docs.
- Prefer the latest docs unless the user names a version. Don't use `/docs/nightly/` pages. They document unreleased work.
- https://tyk.io/docs/llms-full.txt has the full text of all 1,259 latest pages in one file (about 9 MB). Use it only when you need everything at once.
- For product, pricing and comparison pages, see https://tyk.io/llms.txt.

## Start here

- [Tyk Overview](https://tyk.io/docs/tyk-overview.md): What Tyk is and what it can do. Start here for "what is Tyk" questions.
- [Tyk Components](https://tyk.io/docs/tyk-components.md): What each component does (Gateway, Dashboard, Pump, Developer Portal, MDCB and others) and how they fit together.
- [Deployment Options](https://tyk.io/docs/apim.md): How to choose between Tyk Open Source, Tyk Self-Managed and Tyk Cloud.
- [Getting Started](https://tyk.io/docs/getting-started/quick-start.md): Set up a Tyk Self-Managed demo environment.
- [Latest Releases](https://tyk.io/docs/developer-support/release-notes/overview.md): Release notes and Docker images for each component.
- [Long Term Support](https://tyk.io/docs/developer-support/release-types/long-term-support.md): How LTS releases work and how long each one is supported.
- [Upgrading Tyk](https://tyk.io/docs/developer-support/upgrading.md): Upgrade steps for each deployment model.

## AI and MCP

- [AI Management Overview](https://tyk.io/docs/ai-management/overview.md): Explains the difference between AI Studio and MCP Gateway, and which one to use.
- [MCP Gateway](https://tyk.io/docs/ai-management/mcp-gateway/overview.md): Tyk Gateway proxies and governs remote MCP servers. It supports the MCP 2025-11-25 specification from Tyk Gateway v5.13. Start here for "does Tyk support MCP" questions.
- [MCP Gateway Quickstart](https://tyk.io/docs/ai-management/mcp-gateway/quickstart.md): Create a first MCP proxy in Tyk Dashboard in about five minutes.
- [Tyk AI Studio](https://tyk.io/docs/ai-management/ai-studio/overview.md): Manages LLM access, models, budgets and AI applications for platform teams. Includes the Community and Enterprise edition comparison.
- [AI Studio Installation](https://tyk.io/docs/ai-management/ai-studio/installation/overview.md): Install AI Studio with Docker, Kubernetes or Linux packages.
- [Tyk MCP Servers](https://tyk.io/docs/ai-management/mcps/overview.md): Ready-to-use MCP servers for the Tyk Dashboard API and the Tyk docs.

## Install and deploy

- [Tyk Open Source](https://tyk.io/docs/tyk-open-source.md): The open source Tyk Gateway and how to install it.
- [Tyk Self-Managed](https://tyk.io/docs/tyk-self-managed.md): Install the full platform in your own infrastructure.
- [Helm Charts](https://tyk.io/docs/product-stack/tyk-charts/overview.md): Deploy Tyk on Kubernetes with Helm.
- [Tyk Cloud](https://tyk.io/docs/tyk-cloud.md): The fully managed SaaS option.
- [Multi Data Centre Bridge (MDCB)](https://tyk.io/docs/api-management/mdcb.md): Run Gateways across regions or clouds from one control plane.

## Build and manage APIs

- [API Definitions](https://tyk.io/docs/api-management/gateway-config-introduction.md): How Tyk Gateway processes requests and how API definitions configure it.
- [Tyk OAS API Definitions](https://tyk.io/docs/api-management/gateway-config-tyk-oas.md): Configure APIs with the OpenAPI Specification and the `x-tyk-api-gateway` extension.
- [GraphQL](https://tyk.io/docs/api-management/graphql.md): Manage GraphQL APIs and Universal Data Graph.
- [Tyk Streams](https://tyk.io/docs/api-management/event-driven-apis.md): Event-driven APIs over Kafka, WebSocket and SSE.
- [Client Authentication](https://tyk.io/docs/api-management/client-authentication.md): Choose and configure an authentication method, such as API keys, JWT, OAuth 2.0 or mTLS.
- [Upstream Authentication](https://tyk.io/docs/api-management/upstream-authentication.md): How Tyk Gateway authenticates to upstream services.
- [Access Control](https://tyk.io/docs/api-management/access-control/overview.md): Sessions, keys and security policies.
- [Rate Limiting](https://tyk.io/docs/api-management/rate-limit.md): Rate limits and quotas.
- [Response Caching](https://tyk.io/docs/api-management/response-caching.md): Cache upstream responses.
- [Routing Traffic](https://tyk.io/docs/api-management/routing-traffic/overview.md): How Tyk Gateway routes requests to their destinations.
- [Traffic Transformation](https://tyk.io/docs/api-management/traffic-transformation.md): Change requests and responses with middleware.
- [Custom Plugins](https://tyk.io/docs/api-management/plugins/overview.md): Extend Tyk Gateway with plugins in Go, JavaScript, Python, Lua and gRPC.
- [OpenTelemetry](https://tyk.io/docs/api-management/observability.md): Traces, metrics and logs from Tyk Gateway.
- [Tyk Pump](https://tyk.io/docs/api-management/tyk-pump.md): Export analytics to data stores and monitoring tools.
- [API Versioning](https://tyk.io/docs/api-management/api-versioning.md): Run multiple versions of an API.
- [Automation Tools](https://tyk.io/docs/api-management/automations.md): Tyk Operator for Kubernetes and Tyk Sync for moving APIs between environments.

## Platform management

- [Tyk Dashboard](https://tyk.io/docs/api-management/dashboard-configuration.md): The control plane for the Tyk platform and its data stores.
- [Tyk Governance](https://tyk.io/docs/tyk-governance/overview.md): Define API standards and check APIs against them.
- [Dashboard Analytics](https://tyk.io/docs/api-management/dashboard-analytics.md): Where the analytics and log data in Tyk Dashboard come from.
- [User Management](https://tyk.io/docs/api-management/user-management.md): Users, teams, permissions and RBAC in Tyk Dashboard.
- [Tyk Identity Broker](https://tyk.io/docs/tyk-identity-broker/overview.md): Connect external identity providers for SSO.

## Developer Portal

- [Developer Portal](https://tyk.io/docs/portal/overview/intro.md): What the Tyk Developer Portal is and its main features.
- [Set Up the Developer Portal](https://tyk.io/docs/portal/overview/getting-started.md): First-time setup.
- [Install the Developer Portal](https://tyk.io/docs/portal/install.md): Install with Docker, Kubernetes or Linux packages.
- [API Products](https://tyk.io/docs/portal/api-products.md): Publish APIs as products for developers.
- [Customization](https://tyk.io/docs/portal/customization.md): Themes, templates and other customization options.

## Reference

- [Tyk Gateway Configuration](https://tyk.io/docs/tyk-oss-gateway/configuration.md): All Tyk Gateway configuration options and environment variables.
- [Tyk Dashboard Configuration](https://tyk.io/docs/tyk-dashboard/configuration.md): All Tyk Dashboard configuration options and environment variables.
- [Tyk APIs Hub](https://tyk.io/docs/tyk-apis.md): Index of the Tyk component APIs and Postman collections.
- [Tyk Gateway API](https://tyk.io/docs/tyk-gateway-api.md): OpenAPI reference for the Tyk Gateway API.
- [Tyk Dashboard API](https://tyk.io/docs/tyk-dashboard-api.md): OpenAPI reference for the Tyk Dashboard API.
- [Dashboard Admin API](https://tyk.io/docs/dashboard-admin-api.md): OpenAPI reference for provisioning and administering Tyk Dashboard.
- [MDCB API](https://tyk.io/docs/tyk-mdcb-api.md): OpenAPI reference for monitoring MDCB data planes.
- [Developer Portal API](https://tyk.io/docs/product-stack/tyk-enterprise-developer-portal/api-documentation/tyk-edp-api.md): OpenAPI reference for the Tyk Developer Portal.
